items.question: What is Donorfit and who is it designed for?
items.answer: Donorfit is fundraising and donor management software built specifically for non-governmental organizations (NGOs), registered charities, foundations, sponsorship initiatives, and membership associations. It provides a connected platform to manage online giving, recurring donations, sponsorships, group pools, memberships, and donor records.

items.question: Is Donorfit an application for donors to log in, or is it a platform for organizations?
items.answer: Donorfit is an organizational technology platform that powers your nonprofit’s public donation forms, campaign pages, and back-office fundraising operations. Donors receive seamless, branded checkout flows and secure self-service links without needing complex password accounts.

items.question: Where is Donorfit data processed and is it GDPR-compliant?
items.answer: Donorfit is provided by MYFUNDBOX GmbH in Germany and processes personal data in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Connections are encrypted, and organisations can conclude a data processing agreement. Details on hosting and service providers are in our privacy policy.

items.question: Which payment methods does Donorfit support?
items.answer: Payment methods come from the payment provider you connect. Across the integrated providers (Stripe, PayPal, GoCardless, Mollie and Micropayment), they include credit and debit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay, SEPA and Bacs Direct Debit, PayPal, bank transfer, iDEAL and Bancontact. Which methods are available to you depends on the provider and your account.

items.question: How does Donorfit handle charitable tax receipts in Europe?
items.answer: Donorfit provides predefined tax receipt templates for automatic generation, for example for the German Zuwendungsbestätigung. Receipts can be issued per donation or as an annual statement. Your organisation remains responsible for checking that its receipts meet the rules that apply to it.

items.question: How long does it take to implement Donorfit for our organization?
items.answer: Setup takes three steps: configure your cause settings, connect a payment gateway and add the donation box to your website. How long it takes depends mainly on your payment provider’s account verification and on how much existing data you migrate. Our team can help you plan the onboarding.

items.question: Can we embed Donorfit giving widgets into our existing website?
items.answer: Yes. Donorfit forms and campaign widgets can be embedded cleanly into any existing website CMS including WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, Drupal, Typo3, or custom React/HTML sites.

items.question: Can we export our donor data at any time?
items.answer: Yes. You retain 100% ownership of your donor records and financial history. You can export complete CSV, Excel, or JSON data packages at any time with zero lock-in.

items.question: How does Donorfit pricing work?
items.answer: Donorfit is free to use. There is no platform fee, and Donorfit covers the payment gateway processing charges, so your organisation receives the full amount of each donation. Optional add-ons such as Membership, Sponsorship, MoneyPool, Water, Qurbani and Recurring Subscription are purchased separately – see our Pricing page or contact our team for details.

items.question: Is Donorfit free for organisations?
items.answer: Yes. Organisations pay no platform fee and no transaction processing fees to Donorfit. Optional add-on modules are priced separately.

items.question: Who pays the payment gateway processing charges?
items.answer: Donorfit. Under its zero-fee model, Donorfit absorbs the processing charges of the payment gateways you connect, such as Stripe, PayPal and GoCardless.

items.question: Does Donorfit deduct fees from donations?
items.answer: No. Donorfit does not deduct platform or payment processing fees from the amount intended for your organisation.

items.question: How does Donorfit sustain this model?
items.answer: Donorfit is funded by optional paid add-on modules, such as Membership, Sponsorship, MoneyPool, Water, Qurbani and Recurring Subscription, and by exclusive features that organisations choose to buy. The core fundraising platform stays free, Donorfit takes no fees from donations, and donors are not asked for a tip.
